purpose: Answer forms of the exercises releases that check_release_answers.py does not look for: words so generic that this repository uses them in its own text (spike/scripts/check_release_answers.py). By item ID and form, never the answer itself. Each is reviewed: the repository's use must not be about the practice set. Rule (owner, 2026-10-12): when a new exercises release fails the check only because of generic words the repository uses in its own text, the agent adds the exemptions itself, with reasons, without asking; it asks the owner only if a flagged line could be about the practice set itself. The check still never prints or stores an answer.

exempt.why: a length of time; the runbook and the runner state the same span for batch limits
a common clinical initialism; the narration and initialism code use it as an example (ADR 016)
a number word; the repository's code and docs use it throughout
the same number word in another form; used throughout the code and docs
an everyday time phrase; the docs and code use it in their own sense
a profession word; the repository uses it only in a Grammar 3 nominalisation example, in a different setting from the item
the plural of oa-reading-000053 accepted[0], exempt ahead so it does not trip later
a general noun; the design system uses it only as an example of a noun suffix
